blind_audit.rationale: ZAP70 acts in proximal TCR signaling after activated/phosphorylated TCR-CD3 complexes. The failure of anti-CD3 stimulation with preserved PMA/ionomycin response localizes the defect upstream of the pharmacologic bypass and downstream of receptor engagement.

source_currentness.note: GeneReviews was comprehensively updated 2026-06-09 and directly supports normal CD3/CD4, markedly low CD8, impaired anti-CD3 response, and intact PMA/ionomycin bypass.

second_answer_attack.strongest_alternative: C: phosphorylation of CD3 ITAMs by Src-family kinases
second_answer_attack.resolution: That phosphorylation is upstream of ZAP70 recruitment. The named ZAP70 loss plus intact PMA/ionomycin bypass identifies failed propagation from phosphorylated TCR/CD3 complexes to downstream activation, making E uniquely best.

numerical_claims.note: No diagnostic numeric threshold is invented or required.

nearest_material_review.resolution: The nearest production item tests somatostatin/GPCR signaling, not TCR-ZAP70 signaling; no ZAP70, anti-CD3, PMA, or ionomycin term hit exists in production.

adversarial_second_pass.note: Re-read from zero after exact current GeneReviews verification and second-answer/localization attacks; no material defect remained.
